Misrepresenting facts can disrupt harmony in relationships. - **Your words carry weight** (Matthew 12:37: *"Every careless word you speak will be answered in the judgment..."*). Let’s focus on what’s true!"* 3. **Redirect to truth and unity**: *"Remember, Jesus calls us to speak the truth in love (Ephesians 4:15). Let’s keep our words building each other up!"* --- ### **4.
